# PuppyFinder.com

> > PuppyFinder.com is the largest verified marketplace connecting puppy buyers with responsible breeders, rescue organizations, and adoption resources across the USA.

PuppyFinder.com operates as a comprehensive pet marketplace and directory, hosting 2,600+ puppies for sale, 22,500+ dogs for adoption, and 17,741 verified breeders. The platform provides breed selection tools, adoption guidance, and connections to rescue organizations to help users find their ideal dog.

## Browse Puppies & Dogs

- [Puppies for Sale in USA](https://puppyfinder.com/puppies-for-sale): Browse 2626+ puppies for sale including Dachshunds, Labradors, and Bernedoodles across USA
- [Dogs for Adoption in USA](https://puppyfinder.com/dogs-for-adoption): Search 22,500+ dogs available for adoption across USA locations and breeds
- [Upcoming Litters in USA](https://puppyfinder.com/new-dog-litters): Search upcoming litter announcements from verified dog breeders across USA locations
- [Puppies Wanted Ads](https://puppyfinder.com/wanted): Browse wanted ads from people seeking puppies and dogs for adoption or purchase

## Find Breeders & Rescues

- [Verified Dog Breeders in USA](https://puppyfinder.com/breeders): Directory of 17,741 verified dog breeders across USA for Australian Shepherds, Maltese, more
- [Dog Shelters and Rescue Organizations](https://puppyfinder.com/dogs-for-adoption/dog-rescue-organizations): Directory of verified dog shelters and rescue organizations worldwide for adoption
- [Why Advertise on PuppyFinder.com](https://puppyfinder.com/why-advertise): Advertising benefits for breeders: free listings, premium plans, buyer connections
- [Pricing & Ad Placement Options](https://puppyfinder.com/pricing): Pricing and ad placement plans for breeders, rescues, and dog-related businesses

## Dog Breed Reference

- [Complete Dog Breed Directory](https://puppyfinder.com/dog-breeds): Comprehensive directory of pure breeds, mixed breeds, and breed groups with traits
- [Pure Dog Breeds](https://puppyfinder.com/dog-breeds/pure): Reference guide for all pure dog breeds with pictures, traits, and characteristics
- [Mixed & Designer Dog Breeds](https://puppyfinder.com/dog-breeds/mixed): Complete directory of mixed and designer dog breeds with comparison tools
- [Dog Breeds by Category](https://puppyfinder.com/browse-categories): Organized breed categories with listings, puppies, and verified breeders
- [Sporting Group Breeds](https://puppyfinder.com/dog-breeds/group-sporting): AKC Sporting Group breeds: retrievers, pointers, setters for active lifestyles
- [Fast Dog Breeds](https://puppyfinder.com/dog-breeds/groups-fast-dog-breeds): Guide to fast, athletic dog breeds like Greyhounds and Border Collies
- [Breeds Starting with 'A'](https://puppyfinder.com/dog-breeds/letter-a): Alphabetical breed directory for breeds starting with 'A' including traits and mixes

## Breed Selection & Guidance

- [Dog Breed Selector Tool](https://puppyfinder.com/dog-breed-selector): Interactive breed selector tool to match users with ideal dog breeds by traits
- [Adoption Tips & Best Practices](https://puppyfinder.com/tips/adoption): Guide with adoption tips and best practices before adopting a puppy or dog
